scope: Bounded V2-to-V3 changed-function source review of Windows parent-chain repair; not Type-B or full integrated-entry certification

blockers.title: Actual worker OS command is not verified on the direct-parent path; canonical visual worker CLI is self-derived
blockers.evidence: require_worker_parent never calls current.cmdline(). Both callers synthesize expected_command from intended interpreter flags plus sys.argv, and the helper compares the suffix to that same sys.argv. Direct-parent mock with actual -B omitted is accepted and receipt asserts -B. Visual helper also accepts equivalent duplicated method options because there is no independent canonical reconstruction/comparison of its full invocation. Reward pre-launch COMMAND artifact mitigates script-argument drift but does not establish actual interpreter flags.
blockers.impact: Violates the requested exact-worker-CLI rejection and evidence contract. Not a reproduced real launch failure or evidence of changed numerical/scientific behavior; the fixed parent ordinarily constructs the intended command.
blockers.required_closure: Compare observed current-worker OS cmdline against an independently reconstructed canonical worker command on both admitted parent paths, preserving the legitimate isolated-argv0/base-native-executable Windows venv distinction. Retain logical-parent creation-time and actual-Popen-PID receipt checks. Obtain a new bounded source disposition after any repair.

findings.detail: Direct logical parent or exactly one declared Windows venv launcher only; no ancestor search. Launcher executable/command and logical parent PID+creation time+same entry run prefix are checked. Mocks reject unknown launcher, altered launcher command, extra layer, reused logical PID, wrong action/entry, non-Windows intermediary and absent direct parent. Actual current-worker command omission is B4.

Receipts distinguish native worker and launcher. Both parents compare receipt launched_pid to their actual Popen process.pid after zero exit and before result acceptance; wrong Popen PID and parent creation time fail mocked receipt checks. No worker admission relies on post-Popen parent files.

Existing helper functions are AST-identical to V2. Actual caller/interpreter/metadata/NumPy ownership, imported worker runtime/GPU/CPU+interop checks, current strict1800 witness ordering, frozen source/raw/schedule review guards, arm-boundary and completion checks remain. No live gate or model execution is asserted.

Frozen baseline and public resource files remain byte-identical. No changed formula/RNG/splits/seeds/critic/bootstrap/final-buffer/numerical or output validators. Reward 32train/8validation/30users/35servers and visual 8decisions/30users/4servers/full30s drain unchanged. No retries, partial merge or formal scope extension introduced.

V2 failed output, permanent lock, reward plan/registry/four schedule files and complete review pairs retained; no Full arm directory or second-arm result present. Traceback precedes resource/model work. Prepared visual evidence reports zero model calls; semantic run lock absent. V3 reader uses its own independent_repair_rereview and current nine-source map; old approval/plan cannot stand in for V3 preparation.

Retain D2 complete review warnings: small-budget coverage, post-update finite checks, crash/partial evidence, limited independent parent output re-audit, reward/visual validation distinctions, old-plan scope, resource point-in-time and source/package/import/TOCTOU limits, workflow rather than immutable cryptographic process attestation. This changed-function review does not re-certify the entire frozen closure.
